pass.answer: Yes. `git check-attr eol -- notes/draft.md` reports `eol: lf`: check-attr answers for any path, tracked or not, and the hook normalizes the first write to a new file exactly as it does an edit to a tracked one.

fail.answer: Only once you commit it: the rule applies to tracked files.
Yes, notes/draft.md resolves to eol: lf.
fail.why: near miss: no why for untracked paths or a first write
